name: 28369-sharegpt-v2lite-8gpu
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 -- a WHOLE a3 node (`--gres=gpu:8`), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=8, expert parallel ON, expert-parallel load balancing ON. Expert-parallel size is tp x dp = 8, so the 64 routed experts land 8 per rank and none is split. One AsyncLLM with eight engine cores on one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1000, bounded at 1000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion (750 scored). One stream per conversation, so all 1000 are dispatched at once and the run is a single burst that drains -- the reference reported `Peak concurrent requests: 1000.00` for exactly this reason.
workload: 1000 real ShareGPT conversations, checked in at `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-v2lite.jsonl` and rebuildable by `configs/data/make-dataset.py` (seed-0 shuffle of ShareGPT_V3_unfiltered_cleaned_split.json, prompt = turn 0 and reply = turn 1, kept only if 4 <= prompt <= 1024 and prompt + reply <= 2048; the script asserts the 236142-token prompt total, so a rebuild that drifts fails loudly). Single turn, sent as a plain completion (`request_format: plain`) with no chat template. Prompt mean 236.1 tokens (p50 89, p90 692, max 1021), output mean 215.6 (p50 151, p90 514, max 1045); `output_tokens_count` is each conversation's own reply length and IS enforced, so the run generates 215614 tokens and does not stop at EOS.
purpose: A mixture-of-experts chat assistant handling 1000 simultaneous single-turn conversations in one burst across eight GPUs.
launch:
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite

# `deepseek_v2` is not a model_type the pinned transformers knows, so AutoConfig cannot load
# this repo's config without trust-remote-code.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
data-parallel-size: 8
enable-expert-parallel: true

enable-eplb: true

# Must stay inline JSON on one line: the flat reader skips indented lines, so a block mapping
# here drops the key and the engine starts with no EPLB config at all.
eplb-config: {"window_size": 100, "step_interval": 100}

max-num-seqs: 512
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
